content:
**BLUF:** Houthi forces consolidated gains on Perim Island, Mokha, and Dhubab in the Bab el-Mandeb Strait on 11 September, triggering a Saudi east-west pipeline shutdown after attacks and pushing Brent crude above $100/bbl with reduced Hormuz traffic. Ukraine and Russia traded long-range drone and missile strikes, with civilian deaths and injuries reported on both sides including Kyiv residential hits and Russian regional targets. Belarus launched a nationwide army readiness inspection explicitly referencing possible mobilization measures. CISA added three actively exploited vulnerabilities (two JFrog Artifactory, one ConnectWise ScreenConnect) to the KEV catalog. Taiwan recorded routine PLA activity with no surge. Most other theatres remained quiet in the 12-hour window.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2026/09/11/world/middleeast/houthis-yemen-red-sea-shipping-maps.html)[[2]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c23x72yx2rvo)[[3]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-strikes-ukraine-with-missile-and-161-1789107354.html)[[4]](https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-air-strikes-injure-two-cause-fire-9-storey-apartment-building-kyiv-2026-09-11/)[[5]](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/09/11/8052980/)[[6]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/09/11/cisa-adds-three-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

## 1. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Reuters, RBC-Ukraine, Kyiv Independent and Ukrainska Pravda (11 Sep, morning–afternoon UTC) reported Russian missile and ~161-drone attack (including jet-powered Shahed-types) on Ukraine, with strikes hitting Kyiv (fire in 9-storey residential building, 8 injured), Pavlohrad (5 killed), and other sites; Ukrainian air defences claimed 138 drones neutralized. Matters because it marks resumption of sustained capital strikes post-US envoy pause, with civilian infrastructure targeted.[[3]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/russia-strikes-ukraine-with-missile-and-161-1789107354.html)[[4]](https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-air-strikes-injure-two-cause-fire-9-storey-apartment-building-kyiv-2026-09-11/)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Reuters and regional governors (11 Sep, overnight/early morning UTC) reported Ukrainian drones striking Tula region (2 civilians killed, 3 injured), Ozon logistics hub in Saratov (fire, no casualties reported), and industrial facility in Volgograd (debris damage, 2 injured in residential areas). Matters because it demonstrates continued Ukrainian deep-strike reach on Russian logistics and rear-area targets amid mutual escalation.[[4]](https://www.reuters.com/world/russian-air-strikes-injure-two-cause-fire-9-storey-apartment-building-kyiv-2026-09-11/)
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Ukrainska Pravda, RBC-Ukraine, LIGA.net and Kyiv Post (11 Sep, afternoon UTC) reported Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko inspecting troops at Obuz-Lesnovsky training ground and ordering a full armed forces readiness check “up to and including mobilisation,” while stating preparations are “as if we were at war.” Matters because it signals potential force posture changes near the Ukrainian border, though Lukashenko reiterated no intent to attack neighbours.[[5]](https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/09/11/8052980/)[[7]](https://newsukraine.rbc.ua/news/belarus-could-mobilize-troops-as-entire-army-1789129045.html)

### MIDDLE EAST
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Reuters, BBC, NYT, The National and multiple Yemeni government sources (11 Sep, morning–afternoon UTC) reported Houthi forces reaching and seizing Perim (Mayyun) Island plus mainland Dhubab after capturing Mokha port; Saudi east-west oil pipeline shut after multiple attacks. Matters because it tightens Houthi/Iranian proxy control over the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint, compounding Hormuz disruptions and driving oil prices above $100/bbl with sharply reduced tanker traffic.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2026/09/11/world/middleeast/houthis-yemen-red-sea-shipping-maps.html)[[2]](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c23x72yx2rvo)[[8]](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/yemens-houthis-reach-strategic-island-mouth-vital-shipping-lane-2026-09-11/)

### INDO-PACIFIC
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Taiwan News and Taiwan MND (11 Sep, reporting 24h to 06:00 local) tracked 11 Chinese military aircraft (10 entering southwestern/eastern ADIZ) plus 8 naval vessels and 2 official ships; routine monitoring response. Matters as baseline gray-zone activity with no reported surge or median-line crossing escalation beyond pattern.[[9]](https://taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6438029)

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential.

### AFRICA
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential. (Isolated reporting on Algeria-UAE diplomatic rupture and Sudan RSF supply routes noted but no acute shift in Sahel/Horn conflict dynamics within the collection period.)

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No verifiable new developments matching standing requirements or otherwise consequential. (Routine cartel-related statements and Haiti deportation flights reported but no large-scale incidents or policy shifts.)

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Reuters (reporting on spring activity disclosed 10–11 Sep) detailed NATO (UK/Norway/US) tracking of Russian submarine and deep-sea vehicle tests near Svalbard of technology designed to disable undersea cables without visible traces; no actual damage occurred and Russia was notified. Matters because it confirms ongoing Russian interest in critical undersea infrastructure interdiction in the Arctic/North Atlantic.[[10]](https://www.irishtimes.com/world/europe/2026/09/11/nato-allies-say-they-foiled-russian-subsea-cable-sabotage-plot/)

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
- [OSINT - CONFIRMED] Multiple outlets including NYT, The National and Reuters (11 Sep) reported Brent crude briefly exceeding $108–109/bbl and closing above $100 amid Houthi Red Sea gains, Saudi pipeline closure, and Hormuz traffic at multi-month lows (as few as 7 vessels on one day). Matters because chokepoint pressure is compounding global supply constraints with visible price and rerouting effects.[[11]](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/11/business/iran-war-hormuz-red-sea.html)

## 2. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
- [SIGINT - VERIFIED] CISA (11 Sep, official alert) added three vulnerabilities to the KEV catalog due to active exploitation: CVE-2026-42016 and CVE-2026-42018 (JFrog Artifactory authorization/authentication issues) and CVE-2026-84869 (ConnectWise ScreenConnect privilege management/authorization flaw allowing unauthorized file transfer and execution). Federal agencies directed to remediate per BOD 26-04 timelines. Matters because these are edge-device and remote-access vectors with confirmed in-the-wild use, requiring immediate patching in critical networks.[[6]](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/09/11/cisa-adds-three-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)

## 3. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window. No incidents affecting civil aviation, rail, ports, power, water, or telecoms reported. No change to domestic critical infrastructure posture.

## 4. UAP/UFO
Quiet in window. No official statements, hearings, or document releases.

## 5. FRONTIER AND CONSCIOUSNESS RESEARCH
Quiet in window. No peer-reviewed publications or funded programme announcements of note.

**Assessment (geopolitical theatres):** Mutual long-range strike campaigns between Russia and Ukraine are sustaining pressure on rear-area logistics and civilian areas without decisive battlefield shifts; Belarus’s readiness check introduces a new variable for NATO monitoring but lacks immediate mobilization indicators. Houthi territorial consolidation in Yemen represents the most consequential delta, directly threatening a second major maritime chokepoint and elevating energy market risk in an already constrained environment. Evidence from multiple independent outlets converges on the Houthi gains and price response; Belarus statements are state-sourced but corroborated across Ukrainian and Belarusian reporting.

**Assessment (cyber/infrastructure):** CISA’s KEV additions highlight active exploitation of remote-management tools; federal and critical-infrastructure operators face short remediation windows. No confirmed downstream incidents yet, but the vector profile matches prior edge-device campaigns.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Expanded Houthi attacks or effective blockade on non-Saudi shipping through Bab el-Mandeb → further insurance spikes and Suez rerouting → first visible in Lloyd’s List or maritime advisories.
- Belarus mobilization orders or large-scale exercises near Ukrainian border → heightened NATO air policing or intelligence alerts → first in Belarus state media or Ukrainian reporting.
- Confirmed exploitation of new JFrog/ConnectWise KEVs in critical infrastructure or federal networks → broader campaign targeting edge devices → CISA incident notification or sector alerts.
- Surge in PLA aircraft/naval activity east of Taiwan beyond baseline → testing of blockade or gray-zone escalation → Taiwan MND daily reports.
- Additional Ukrainian strikes on Russian refining/logistics (e.g., follow-ons to Saratov/Volgograd) → Russian retaliation on Ukrainian energy/urban targets → Ukrainian Air Force or regional governor statements.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of exact damage and casualties from Ukrainian strikes on Saratov refinery/Ozon hub and Russian strikes on Ukrainian sites.
- Full scope of Houthi control over Perim Island, any immediate shipping incidents, or Saudi/coalition responses.
- Details on any Belarus mobilization timeline or specific units affected.
- Verification of any unreported strikes or incidents in quiet theatres (South/Central Asia, Africa, Americas).
